source_grade_note: Published FSSAI FSSR chapter PDFs, original pages visually inspected. FSSAI compendium is an editorial consolidation; original operative Gazette prevails in event of conflict. Neither product definition nor a published composition parameter proves an exact contaminant table limit applies to actual as-sold product.

identity_screens.product_name: Drinking Water (Purified) sold through vending machine

retained_batch48_reference.identity_finding: Vended purified drinking water is expressly distinct from packaged drinking water or mineral water; IS:10500 is referenced.
Coffee-chicory mixture of roasted ground forms requires coffee at least 51% by mass; instant and decaffeinated variants have separate descriptions.

new_batch49_source.published_product_identity_fact: Frozen fruits or fruit products may be frozen in blocks or individually quick-frozen; standard concerns properly prepared fruit for direct consumption where required.
new_batch49_source.contaminant_comparator_not_automatically: No generic single pesticide residue comparator may be assigned to unspecified frozen fruits; fruit species, named pesticide/residue definition and processing factor are required.
new_batch49_source.missing_actual_documentary_evidence: Confirm named fruit/crop, IQF versus block freezing, declared pesticide residue, processing status and actual sampled lot.

retained_batch48_reference.identity_finding: Catechu (edible) is dried aqueous extract of Acacia catechu heartwood with own identity and quality criteria.
Seedless tamarind comes from mature ripe Tamarindus indica fruit after removing outer cover and seeds; FSSR separately states moisture and ash quality criteria.
Coconut milk powder is spray-dried/dehydrated coconut milk; maltodextrin AND sodium caseinate may be added; fat at least 60% on dry basis.
Cocoa beans are properly fermented and dried whole seeds of Theobroma cacao.

identity_screens.product_name: Dry Mixtures of Cocoa and Sugars

new_batch49_source.published_product_identity_fact: Dry mixtures of cocoa and sugars are distinct foods intended for direct consumption; cocoa cake is transformed into powder. The standard lists moisture max 7% and cocoa-powder fractions by product designation.
new_batch49_source.contaminant_comparator_not_automatically: Do not treat an as-sold sweetened cocoa mix as 100% cocoa powder, nor apply cocoa-powder dry fat-free lead value without a defined CTR article.
new_batch49_source.missing_actual_documentary_evidence: Document actual cocoa solids%, sugar%, cocoa powder fat category, moisture, as-sold name and signed legal CTR article.

identity_screens.product_name: Cocoa mass or Cocoa/Chocolate Liquor and Cocoa Cake

new_batch49_source.published_product_identity_fact: Cocoa mass/liquor is ground from practically shell-free cocoa nibs, while cocoa cake results from fat removal; stated cocoa mass cocoa-butter content is 47–60% by weight.
new_batch49_source.contaminant_comparator_not_automatically: Mass, cake and cocoa powder are different matrices and processing states. A lead method excluding samples with ≥40% fat is not assumed valid for mass.
new_batch49_source.missing_actual_documentary_evidence: Specify whether cocoa mass/liquor or pressed cake, measured cocoa-butter fat%, alkalisation state, sample preparation, laboratory accreditation and signed CTR article.

new_batch49_source.published_product_identity_fact: The chia-seed entry names Salvia hispanica L. as coming from the mint family (Labiatae) and sets separate chia seed product specifications.
new_batch49_source.contaminant_comparator_not_automatically: Chapter 2.4 placement and seed form do not automatically make mint-family chia cereal grain for a lead limit.
new_batch49_source.missing_actual_documentary_evidence: Confirm Salvia hispanica identity, whole seed vs flour/mix, producer specifications and signed CTR commodity class.

retained_batch48_reference.identity_finding: Carob powder is obtained from roasted pods of Ceratonia siliqua and has its own quality specification.

new_batch49_source.published_product_identity_fact: Arrowroot is expressly defined as separated purified starch from rhizomes of Maranta arundinacea or Curcuma angustifolia (FSSAI spelling as published: augustifolia).
new_batch49_source.contaminant_comparator_not_automatically: Purified rhizome starch is not wheat/cereal flour; broad 'pesticide residues' is not an analyte or numeric MRL.
new_batch49_source.missing_actual_documentary_evidence: Prove actual botanical source, purified starch form and processing, named pesticide, residue definition and crop/starch commodity MRL.

retained_batch48_reference.identity_finding: Water chestnut flour is ground dried nuts of Trapa bispinosa or T. quadrispinosa.

new_batch49_source.published_product_identity_fact: Animal casings are cylindrical membranes derived from large or small intestines, oesophagus or urinary bladder of slaughtered food animals; product may be dried or wet salted.
new_batch49_source.contaminant_comparator_not_automatically: Animal-origin intestinal casing is not automatically muscle meat or rendered animal fat under CTR lead classifications.
new_batch49_source.missing_actual_documentary_evidence: Establish slaughtered species, gut or bladder source, wet-salted/dried/brine concentration, matrix method and legal lead article.

new_batch49_source.published_product_identity_fact: Egg powder is dried liquid contents of hens' Gallus gallus eggs; standard differentiates whole egg, yolk and white powders and a maximum moisture of 2.0% for each.
new_batch49_source.contaminant_comparator_not_automatically: Dry powdered whole egg, yolk and white are not automatically tested on fresh shell-free egg basis; no pesticide identity or MRL has been established.
new_batch49_source.missing_actual_documentary_evidence: Confirm powder fraction, hen source, batch drying yields, original egg fraction, individual pesticide/residue definition and statutory comparison basis.

new_batch49_source.published_product_identity_fact: Pickled eggs are made from hard-boiled peeled hen or quail eggs in a pickle solution of salt, water, oil, acids and seasonings; the standard describes pickling at pH 3.2–3.6.
new_batch49_source.contaminant_comparator_not_automatically: A preserved egg-plus-brine as-sold product is not automatically equivalent to unprocessed shell-free whole egg for pesticide MRL interpretation.
new_batch49_source.missing_actual_documentary_evidence: Confirm hen/quail source, drained edible egg percentage, brine composition, hard-boiled treatment and named pesticide/commodity residue basis.

retained_batch48_reference.identity_finding: Dried glucose syrup is powdered, at least 93% solids and at most 1.0% sulphated ash.
Edible lactose is whey-derived disaccharide, at least 99% lactose on dry basis and at most 0.3% sulphated ash.
Misri is candy from sugar or palmyrah juice and has total ash no more than 0.4%.

identity_screens.product_name: Polyols permitted under Appendix-A of FSS(FPS&FA) Regulations,2011 excluding those already standardized

new_batch49_source.published_product_identity_fact: Salt substitutes are separately specified mixtures of permitted cation salts/acids; sodium content shall not exceed 120 mg per 100 g of the salt substitute mixture.
new_batch49_source.contaminant_comparator_not_automatically: A low-sodium salt substitute is not automatically ordinary sodium chloride edible salt for lead, and its sodium-content quality criterion is not a lead limit.
new_batch49_source.missing_actual_documentary_evidence: Provide as-sold cation profile, full allowed salts/additives, sodium assay, label, trace-lead sample method and signed CTR commodity article.

identity_screens.product_name: Additives permitted under Appendix-A of FSS (FPS&FA) Regulations, 2011 and other food safety standards regulations excluding those already standardized and additives of Nutraceutical Regulations
Additives VA-VF of Nutraceutical Regulations excluding those already standardised
Permitted enzymes and their preparations excluding those already listed under Processing Aids and Nutraceutical Regulations
Ingredients listed under Schedule IV, Schedule VI and Schedule VIII of Nutraceutical Regulations
Cow or Buffalo Colostrum and Colostrum Products

retained_batch48_reference.identity_finding: Colostrum from cow/buffalo is separately defined as secretion occurring in the first days after parturition; a separate colostrum-products standard exists.

new_batch49_source.published_product_identity_fact: Royal jelly is additive-free secretion from hypopharyngeal and mandibular glands of worker bees, unlike honey. The standard distinguishes type 1 and type 2 bee diets and lists 10-HDA as a characteristic component.
new_batch49_source.contaminant_comparator_not_automatically: Honey, royal jelly, beeswax and animal muscle tissue are not interchangeable for antibiotics CTR; an unidentified 'antibiotics' label has no single test/MRL.
new_batch49_source.missing_actual_documentary_evidence: Identify specific antimicrobial residue(s), bee product/feed history, pure royal jelly versus formulation, validated royal-jelly assay and legal residue article.

retained_batch48_reference.identity_finding: Food-grade silver leaf is sheet-form silver of at least 999/1000 fineness, at most 2.8 g/m², and excludes animal-origin manufacturing materials.
Dextrin-soluble dietary fibre is specifically defined as purified polymer from dextrinification of starch, distinct from conventional maltodextrin.

nine_high_value_boundaries: Cocoa mass is 47–60% cocoa butter in FSSR; do not apply a high-fat-excluding method by number alone.
Sweetened cocoa mix cocoa-powder fraction is not pure cocoa powder lead sample basis.
Chia is a mint-family seed; Chapter 2.4 placement does not automatically establish a cereal CTR article.
Arrowroot is purified rhizome starch, not a named cereal or pesticide residue analyte.
Casings are intestine/oesophagus/bladder, not automatically muscle meat.
Egg powder may be whole/yolk/white with different concentration ratios.
Pickled eggs combine peeled eggs and acidic brine; fresh shell-free egg values do not transfer without legal evidence.
Salt substitutes' sodium ≤120 mg/100 g standard is not a lead contaminant maximum.
Royal jelly is gland secretion with type 1/type 2 bee diets; it is not generic honey antibiotic limits.
